themes_detail.label: Tree Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints spiked to 10 THIS WEEK—a 2567% jump from the 0.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 13.83)—suggesting either recent severe weather, disease outbreak, or maintenance neglect affecting the Upper West Side's canopy.
evidence: 10 damaged tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 13.83 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Long-standing CB budget request for park/amenity reconstruction suggests underlying infrastructure concerns
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department about recent storms or disease affecting neighborhood trees; obtain tree inventory data for CD 107
Canvass affected blocks (Broadway, Central Park West, Amsterdam Ave) with photos; speak to residents about safety concerns from falling branches

themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints exploded to 78 THIS WEEK—a 252% spike from the 22.1-complaint weekly average (z-score: 6.43)—coupled with a 522% surge in street sweeping complaints (7 last week vs. 1.1 avg) and 500% spike in traffic complaints (3 this week vs. 0.5 avg), pointing to acute pavement failure or debris accumulation.
evidence: 78 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 22.1 weekly average (252% increase, z-score: 6.43)
7 street sweeping complaints last week vs. 1.1 weekly average (522% increase, z-score: 5.58)
3 traffic complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (500% increase, z-score: 5.0)
reporting_angles: Request DOT street condition survey data for CD 107; identify specific problem corridors (likely major avenues like Broadway, Amsterdam, Columbus)
Document deteriorated blocks with photos; interview residents about potholes, flooding, or debris; ask Sanitation Dept about collection schedule disruptions

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints surged to 17 LAST WEEK—a 656% jump from the 2.2-complaint weekly average (z-score: 7.68)—indicating potential infrastructure breakdown, blockages, or contamination events in the neighborhood's subsurface systems.
evidence: 17 sewer complaints last week vs. 2.2 weekly average (656% increase, z-score: 7.68)
Spike concentrated in single recent week, suggesting acute event rather than chronic condition
DEP infrastructure maintenance records likely available for verification
reporting_angles: Contact DEP about recent sewer blockages, main breaks, or overflow events in CD 107; request sewage infrastructure age/condition data
Interview residents near major sewers (e.g., areas draining to Riverside Park) about odors, backups, or visible contamination

themes_detail.label: Indoor Air Quality Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints jumped to 10 LAST WEEK—a 167% spike from the 3.8-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.23)—potentially signaling heating system failures, mold outbreaks, or ventilation breakdowns across residential buildings.
evidence: 10 indoor air quality complaints last week vs. 3.8 weekly average (167% increase, z-score: 4.23)
Timing aligns with heating season; may correlate with heating/hot water complaints (3012 total over 90 days, suggesting chronic building maintenance issues)
Long-standing CB request for code enforcement expansion suggests building violations are persistent problem
reporting_angles: Contact DOHMH and Buildings Dept to identify buildings with multiple air quality complaints; investigate heating system violations
Interview residents in flagged buildings about symptoms (respiratory issues, mold); document visible mold or ventilation failures

themes_detail.label: Vehicle Noise Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints surged to 30 LAST WEEK—a 176% increase from the 10.9-complaint weekly average (z-score: 6.34)—suggesting either increased traffic congestion, loud vehicle modifications, or construction activity on major thoroughfares.
evidence: 30 vehicle noise complaints last week vs. 10.9 weekly average (176% increase, z-score: 6.34)
Complements broader noise complaints across category (helicopter, residential, generic noise = 3,583 total complaints over 90 days)
NYPD traffic enforcement and DOT construction permit data available for cross-reference
reporting_angles: Review NYPD noise complaint response data and traffic enforcement citations for CD 107; identify specific trouble corridors
Interview community residents; request DOT construction permit logs to determine if major work is ongoing on Broadway, Amsterdam, or Columbus Ave
